name: Hamish Kingsbury
story: Hamish Kingsbury's professional work includes information-systems consultancy and geospatial services. His career profile records study at the University of Canterbury, including a distinction in 2014–15, and work with Stantec in Christchurch. The automated service-authoring work discussed in the book forms part of this combination of spatial information and software practice.
Hamish Kingsbury presented automated service authoring in 2018.
A LINZ geospatial student or graduate profile records Hamish Kingsbury: Senior Spatial Data Specialist, Abley; 2015 NZ Esri Young Scholar and NZ Spatial Excellence undergraduate award.
